Tobias sat on the rocks a long while, turning the paper over, wondering what became of the hand that wrote it, and whether the sea ever gives back what it takes.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡荡的街道上，偶尔有一辆出租车缓缓驶过，车灯划开薄薄的雾气。便利店的玻璃门里透出冷白的光，店员靠着柜台打盹，货架上的关东煮还在小火咕嘟。远处传来清洁车的声音，清洁工推着扫帚，扫过落叶和昨夜的喧嚣。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有极少数还亮着灯，不知是加班还是失眠。江面上起了雾，货船的汽笛低低响了一声，像是在提醒这座城市，天快亮了。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine Russian nesting dolls: to open the big one, you open the one inside it, and so on, until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open anymore.\n- That tiniest doll is called the 'base case', and it's what stops the function from calling itself forever."}
